method.isolation: One fresh Node child per input/operation, sequential; disk read and setup excluded from operation timer
method.gc: Explicit gc before each sample, outside timer; warmup/result checks excluded
method.memory: process.memoryUsage before/after byte snapshots while operation output is retained; includes runtime/setup, NOT allocation peaks or browser/GPU memory
method.canvas: Node projectCanvasGraph+canvasLayout only. Expanded scope maximizes visible direct children; synthetic9999 cases explicitly use the UI cross-call operator mode. Real models keep default single-invocation module drill-through. Boundary nodes are separate from operators. DOM paint/interaction is measured separately.
method.host: Shared desktop; no active4311 gate, no claim of a fully idle or isolated machine
method.scope: Representative fixed models and actual budget-bound synthetic empty/referenced/connected graphs. Not a guarantee for arbitrary per-node tensor/formula complexity, scans or whole-family support.
